jobs.title: Remote Senior SMP Project Manager (Industrial Construction)
jobs.description:
Description

PERMANENT POSITION

Status: Full-Time, Exempt

Location: Remote, but must travel in person to project sites throughout the U.S. as needed

Travel Requirements: 60% to 80%

Compensation: Based on Experience

Area of Specialty Desired: Structural, Mechanical, and Piping (SMP)

Position Summary

:

The successful Senior SMP Project Manager will drive GBI’s safe work culture and high-quality work through management of people, resources, and customer expectations; resulting in on-time completion schedules and profitability for GBI.

Reports To

Director of SMP Services

Primary Duties

: (this is not meant to be an exhaustive list of all work being performed)

Strictly enforce safe work performance on all assigned projects.

Manage daily interaction and planning with customers, field superintendents, field crews and all GBI departments (Engineering, Fabrication, Field Warehouse, Purchasing, QA/QC, Safety, Administration, ++).

Serve as primary contact with customers.

Provide regular reporting of project progress including any variances.

Coordinate daily with sub-contractors (and consortium partners as applicable) regarding project details and compliance.

Maintain project schedules and expenditures to budgeted amounts; Optimize project cash flow.

Manage change order process and claims management.

Facilitate harmonious project execution with all parties involved, ensuring resolution to any issues that may arise.

Gather data for bids/estimates.

Verify accuracy of reports, closeout books, purchase orders and invoices.

Other duties as assigned.

Wisely allocate resources (people, equipment, materials) to ensure that all project phases are completed in a timely and cost-effective manner.

Responsible for close-out of project after ensuring the accurate completion of required work and documents, submittals required to the customer, and final payment.

Proven track-record of success in leading people.

Strong focus on safe work performance (OSHA, MSHA).

Strong ability to work well with others.

Ability to interact throughout organization within Standard Work Process Map.

Ability to multi-task and to work independently and with minimal direction.

Proven ability to communicate effectively in writing, verbally and in-person.

Proficient in MS Word, Excel, Outlook, Project.

Ability to represent GBI in a professional manner.

Ability to work a flexible work schedule.

Ability to travel as needed.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in construction management or related field.

Minimum of six (6) years prior experience in construction, managing projects $5M + (industrial industry).

Benefits

Full Benefits including Health, Dental, Vision, 401K, etc.

Vacation Leave & Holiday Pay

Paid Time Off

401(k)

Health / Dental / Vision Insurance

Life Insurance

Health Savings Accounts (HSAs)

Long-Term & Short-Term Disability

Although headquartered in Kaysville, Utah, we operate fixed-site facilities in Utah, Wyoming, New Mexico, Texas, and Colorado that support construction sites throughout the U.S. and Canada. jobs.description:
Senior eDiscovery Project Manager

Employment Type: Full-Time

Department: Legal

CGS is seeking a Senior eDiscovery Project Manager to join our team supporting the legal organization within a large Federal agency.

CGS brings motivated, highly skilled, and creative people together to solve the government’s most dynamic problems with cutting-edge technology. To carry out our mission, we are seeking candidates who are excited to contribute to government innovation, appreciate collaboration, and can anticipate the needs of others. Here at CGS, we offer an environment in which our employees feel supported, and we encourage professional growth through various learning opportunities.

Skills and attributes for success

Respond to client requests and provide consultation to clients to service all client eDiscovery needs
Create fields, choices, layouts, and views in Relativity
Create batches of records for review in Relativity
Create Production sweeps and sets in Relativity
Develop, modify, and implement workflows, essential resources needed to progress work through the system, and tools being utilized
Initiate work on behalf of clients by crafting and submitting work orders for tasks associated with data processing, review, and production
Conduct quality checks to ensure accuracy and completeness of job instructions and of final work product
Communicate expectations for scope and deadlines to internal and external stakeholders
Establish informed project schedules based on a solid understanding of project activities, sequences of events, dependencies, work effort, duration of tasks across departments, and associated resource requirements based on the complexity of work and the size of the queue
Participate in project tasks including kick-off call preparation and completion, and documentation of workflows, standards, and project closure tasks such as final billing and data destruction
Maintain an understanding of e-discovery, market competitors, and the tools used to support the industry

Qualifications

5 (five) years of eDiscovery/litigation support experience with a focus on client solutions
3 (three) years of progressive more responsible experience on major lit support projects
2 years in Relativity, beyond document review coding
Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills with both eDiscovery technical teams and non-technical business leaders and team player
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment agile work environment
Experience and familiarity with eDiscovery Services covering all realms of the EDRM (File to Trial)
Must be a U.S. Citizen
The ability to obtain a U.S. Government security clearance (active clearance preferred)
BS/BA degree or equivalent work experience (JD highly preferred)
Experience with Government software policies and procedures
Client-facing communication experience
Federal Agency issued security clearance

Ideally, You Will Also Have

Client-facing communication experience
Federal Agency issued security clearance

Our Commitment

Contact Government Services (CGS) strives to simplify and enhance government bureaucracy through the optimization of human, technical, and financial resources. We combine cutting-edge technology with world-class personnel to deliver customized solutions that fit our client’s specific needs. We are committed to solving the most challenging and dynamic problems.

For the past seven years, we’ve been growing our government contracting portfolio, and along the way, we’ve created valuable partnerships by demonstrating a commitment to honesty, professionalism, and quality work.

Here at CGS we value honesty through hard work and self-awareness, professionalism in all we do, and to deliver the best quality to our consumers mending those relations for years to come.

We care about our employees. Therefore, we offer a comprehensive benefits package.

Health, Dental, and Vision
Life Insurance
401k

Paid Time Off and Observance of State/Federal Holidays

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager (Stores)
jobs.description:
Senior, Project Management (REMOTE)
Woodbridge, NJ, United States
Full time Schedule

$129,960 - $216,120
Annually*

* based on job, location, and schedule

PLUS: Vertical (elevator/escalators) experience and/or fire protection experience

Job Description
Be part of an amazing story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.
Job Overview

The Senior, Project Management has direct responsibility for the administration and implementation of all assigned construction and capital projects. The Senior, Project Management coordinates with contracted suppliers and store management to ensure projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. The Senior, Project Management serves as the primary point of contact for the Store Environment teams, disseminating information and facilitating critical project decisions from inception to turnover. The role emphasizes improving the customer shopping experience and requires adaptability to change, consistently championing initiatives that reduce costs and save time. The Senior, Project Management demonstrates a strong sense of urgency and performs effectively under pressure in a collaborative team environment.
What You Will Do

Support the capital approval process, including budget and scope development, and preparation of phasing plans and project schedules.
Oversee construction, bidding, and administration processes in compliance with Capital Control policies and procedures. Participate in developing and maintaining construction cost estimates and forecasts, and manage ongoing budget tracking reports to ensure projects remain within budget.
Build and maintain strong relationships with other Macy’s departments, including Stores, Strategic Procurement, Energy, Risk Management, Capital Planning, and Capital Control, demonstrating effective communication and collaboration skills.
Establish and maintain a network of competitive general contractors, subcontractors, and architectural, mechanical, electrical, and plumbing service suppliers.
Lead strategic initiatives to refine and improve project operations and management processes.
Collaborate with store, district, and regional partners, as well as suppliers, to resolve property damage claims efficiently.
Support the Store Environment team and store organization in efforts to drive sales growth.
Mentor and coach Project Managers as needed or upon request.
Maintain regular, dependable attendance and punctuality.
Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships, and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities.
In addition to the essential duties mentioned above, other duties may be assigned.

Skills You Will Need

Project & Construction Management
: Ability to administer and implement construction and capital projects, oversee bidding and administration processes, and ensure completion on time, within budget, and to high-quality standards.
Financial Acumen
: Skilled in budget development, cost estimation, forecasting, and ongoing budget tracking to ensure projects remain within financial parameters.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
: Builds and maintains strong relationships with internal departments (Stores, Strategic Procurement, Energy, Risk Management, Capital Planning, and Capital Control) and external partners (contractors, subcontractors, and service suppliers) to drive alignment and results.
Strategic Planning & Execution
: Capable of developing phasing plans, project schedules, and strategic initiatives to refine and improve project operations and management processes.
Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills
: Able to identify, assess, and resolve property damage claims, project issues, and operational challenges efficiently.
Communication & Presentation
: Strong verbal and written communication skills; able to present information clearly to customers, leadership, and internal/external partners.
Adaptability & Initiative
: Demonstrates flexibility in a fast-paced environment, champions new initiatives, reduces costs, and saves time.
Who You Are

Candidates with a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in a related field are encouraged to apply. Master’s degree preferred.
This position requires heavy lifting, constant moving, remaining in a stationary position, and reaching with arms and hands. Involves remaining in a stationary position for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 30 lbs. stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders. May involve reaching above eye level. Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment.
Able to work a flexible schedule, including days, evenings, weekends, and holidays, based on department and company needs.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.
Some additional benefits we offer include:
Merchandise discounts
Performance-based incentives
Annual merit review
Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice
Tuition reimbursement

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.
About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.
Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - apply today!

ROWE is currently looking for a Land Development Project Manager to join our team. Project Managers work in a group environment on a diverse range of projects, providing creative leadership to a wide range of staff with varied experience. This position will play a big role in growing our Design Services Division team. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Develop proposals and project plans.

Conduct research and development for projects

Represent clients at public meetings.

Develop work scopes, budgets, and staff assignments.

Conduct research and development for residential subdivisions.

Provide master planning/site layout for residential subdivisions and land development projects.

Review state/local permits for land disturbance, water, and wastewater.

Provide quality control for the design team to ensure technical accuracy, conformance to project requirements, and overall constructability.

Interact with other disciplines (survey and construction).

Provide direction and assistance for construction of land development projects.

Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering.

Michigan Professional Engineer License.

Minimum Of 15 Years Of Civil Site Design Experience.

Proficient in AutoCAD Civil 3D.

Experience with site design, road design, hydraulic analysis, sanitary sewer design and water main design.

Experience developing site plans for large- and small-scale projects.

jobs.title: Project Manager Manutenzione Impianti Rinnovabili
jobs.description:
Azienda

La nostra cliente è una società specializzata nella produzione, trasformazione, trasporto, acquisto e vendita di energia elettrica e termica a servizio di un importante scalo aeroportuale internazionale. Gestisce un parco impianti diversificato (impianti fotovoltaici, sistemi di accumulo BESS, impianti di cogenerazione e una centrale termica alimentata a gas naturale) per garantire la continuità dell'approvvigionamento energetico, nel rispetto degli obiettivi di efficienza, affidabilità e sostenibilità.

Il ruolo

Il ruolo richiede la capacità di leggere gli impianti e solide conoscenze in ottica manutentiva, ma non prevede l'esecuzione diretta degli interventi. Il/la Project Manager coordinerà e supervisionerà fornitori e imprese esterne che li realizzano, rappresentandone il riferimento tecnico, e gestirà in autonomia le attività di monitoraggio, pianificazione e conformità.

Responsabilità principali

Monitorare i parametri di esercizio e di efficienza degli impianti, individuando i migliori assetti produttivi e predisponendo il piano di produzione in coerenza con gli obiettivi aziendali
Monitorare le performance degli impianti (produzione, KPI e availability), analizzando gli scostamenti e supervisionando il rispetto degli SLA contrattuali
Pianificare gli interventi di manutenzione ordinaria e straordinaria sulla base della programmazione annuale
Coordinare fornitori e imprese esterne nelle attività di manutenzione correttiva e preventiva
Supportare la gestione dei contratti di O&M e la valutazione delle performance dei fornitori
Gestire le non conformità, promuovendo azioni correttive e preventive in coordinamento con il management
Supportare la predisposizione di report tecnici ed economici per il management
Raccogliere ed elaborare dati a supporto di budget, forecast e business plan
Verificare e aggiornare la documentazione relativa a contratti, autorizzazioni, assicurazioni e adempimenti normativi
Garantire il corretto utilizzo, la manutenzione, la taratura e la verifica di attrezzature e sistemi di misura
Effettuare le verifiche tecnico-amministrative sulle imprese appaltatrici ai sensi dell'art. 26 del D.Lgs. 81/08
Svolgere attività di back office tecnico: monitoraggio dei sistemi SCADA, gestione del ticketing e controllo documentale

Profilo ideale

Laurea magistrale in Ingegneria Energetica
Esperienza di 3-4 anni nella manutenzione di impianti fotovoltaici, sistemi di accumulo (BESS), impianti di cogenerazione e/o centrali elettriche, preferibilmente in realtà industriali o energetiche strutturate
Esperienza nella pianificazione e supervisione della manutenzione ordinaria e straordinaria di infrastrutture impiantistiche complesse, con capacità di valutazione dei livelli di servizio e redazione della contabilità lavori
Buona conoscenza della normativa in materia di salute e sicurezza sul lavoro (D.Lgs. 81/08 e s.m.i.) e della normativa sugli appalti
Buona conoscenza dei software di monitoraggio impianti e dei sistemi SCADA
Ottima conoscenza del pacchetto Microsoft Office, in particolare Excel
Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese

Cosa offriamo

Contratto a tempo indeterminato
RAL indicativa 38.000 - 46.000 €, commisurata all'esperienza realmente maturata

1 giorno a settimana nei primi 3 mesi, poi 3 giorni in presenza a partire dal 4° mese

Welfare aziendale

jobs.title: Project Manager - Higgs Audio (Toronto)
jobs.description:
About The Role

Boson AI builds real-time speech and multimodal AI that makes talking to AI feel like talking to people. Higgs Audio is our family of foundation audio and avatar models. They generate natural speech, recognize speech in many languages, clone a voice from a short sample, detect sentiment, and give a voice a face. Higgs TTS 3, an expressive, open-weight text-to-speech model with zero-shot voice cloning, also powers Higgs VoiceOver, which brings directable AI voice-over into video editors. Customers use Higgs Audio through our API, through hosting partners such as Microsoft Foundry and Deep Infra, and as open weights. Thousands of developers already build on our open models on GitHub and Hugging Face.

We are hiring a Project Manager to run Higgs Audio from research to release. You will plan and ship its releases, hold every release to a clear quality bar, decide which issues get fixed first, keep the schedule on track, and bring what customers tell us back to the team. You will work with the researchers who train the models, the engineers who serve them, and the customers who use them.

This is a hands-on role. You don't need to train models, but you need to be technical enough to reproduce a bug against our API, read an evaluation report, listen critically to generated speech, and tell a real regression from noise. You will start as a senior individual contributor with real ownership of the Higgs Audio releases and roadmap.

The role is based at either our Santa Clara HQ or our Toronto office, on a hybrid schedule with at least three days a week in the office. Expect occasional travel between the two offices and to customers. The ability to speak multiple languages is a plus.

What You'll Do

Own Higgs Audio releases from plan to launch. Set the release schedule, run go/no-go reviews, and make sure each release ships with documentation, release notes, an updated model card and a changelog entry
Coordinate every channel a release goes out on: our API and Boson Workspace, open weights on Hugging Face, our GitHub repositories, hosting partners such as Microsoft Foundry and Deep Infra. Keep them in step, so that no channel falls a version behind without a reason
Run quality control. Work with research and engineering to define the bar a release must clear: error rates across 100+ languages, voice-cloning similarity, expressiveness benchmarks such as our EmergentTTS-Eval, listening tests, latency and cost. Hold every release to it, and catch regressions before customers do
Own the issue queue. Triage bug reports and feature requests from GitHub, customer support, partners and our own teams, set severity and priority, get each one to an owner, and close the loop with whoever reported it
Keep the schedule. Break goals into milestones, track the dependencies between research, engineering and go-to-market, raise risks early, and make tradeoffs explicit when something has to give
Bring the customer into the room. Talk to developers, enterprise customers, partners and creators, run beta programs, read usage data and support tickets, and turn what you learn into clear requirements and priorities for the team
Make sure model changes land smoothly in the products built on them, such as Higgs VoiceOver, which runs on Higgs TTS 3
Own versioning and deprecation: version names, migration guides, and deprecation notices that give customers time to move before a breaking change
Report what is working. Track metrics such as release cadence, regressions that reached customers, time to resolve critical issues, adoption and customer satisfaction, and send a regular status update that leadership can read in five minutes

What Success Looks Like In Your First Six Months

Higgs Audio ships on a predictable, published release schedule, and every release clears a documented quality bar before it goes out
Every open issue, from our public repos and from customers, has an owner and a priority, and critical bugs are fixed within an agreed time
Customers can follow every model and API change in a public changelog, with notice ahead of any breaking change
A regular customer report drives the Higgs Audio roadmap, and its top requests are scheduled or shipped

Minimum Qualifications

5+ years of project, program or product management on software products, including at least 2 years on technical products such as APIs, developer platforms or ML models
A track record of shipping on schedule: you have run release processes and launch checklists, made go/no-go calls, and can point to releases you were responsible for
Technical fluency: comfortable with Python, REST and streaming APIs, GitHub and issue trackers, and able to reproduce a bug, read logs, and analyze evaluation results in SQL, a spreadsheet or a notebook
Experience turning customer conversations and usage data into prioritized requirements, and the judgment to say no
Clear, concise writing in specs, release notes and status updates
Ability to use agentic AI efficiently in your work, so you can deliver at superhuman level
Able to work from our Santa Clara HQ or our Toronto office on a hybrid schedule

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with speech or audio products, such as TTS, ASR, voice cloning, voice agents, or audio for media production
Experience releasing ML models: evaluation suites, human preference studies, model cards, and open-weight releases on Hugging Face
Experience managing the issues, pull requests and releases of an open-source project on GitHub
Experience with enterprise customers or cloud partners such as Microsoft Foundry, AWS Bedrock or Google Vertex AI
A good ear: you notice when a voice sounds off, and you can say what is wrong
An engineering background, or a degree in computer science, electrical engineering or a related field
Fluency in a language besides English. Our models speak 100+ of them

Boson AI is building AI that people can simply talk to. If you want to own how our speech models reach the people who use them, we'd love to hear from you. Please tell us about releases or products you have shipped and the part you played in them.

This posting is for an existing vacancy. Boson AI uses artificial intelligence (AI) to help screen and assess applications for this position, and our team reviews the shortlisted candidates.

Boson AI is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by law.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Santa Clara HQ: USD 160,000–260,000 per year. Toronto: CAD 140,000–230,000 per year. Where an offer falls in the range depends on experience.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
The Project Manager plays a central role in keeping the team’s work organized, coordinated, and moving forward - helping ensure that client engagements are exceptionally well coordinated, commitments are delivered on time, information is where it needs to be, and nothing falls through the cracks. They will also play an important role in continuously improving how the practice operates - identifying opportunities to streamline processes, reduce administrative effort, and leverage AI and technology to create greater efficiency, consistency, and capacity as the practice grows.

Working across multiple client engagements and internal priorities, the Project Manager brings structure, organization and momentum to the practice. They anticipate what is coming, connect the dots across projects, follow through on important details and help create a seamless experience for our clients, the Leadership Consulting team, and broader team members across the country and around the world.

As the practice continues to grow, this role will also help us build the processes, tools and ways of working that allow us to operate efficiently and consistently at greater scale.

This is a full-time hybrid role within Boyden’s Leadership Consulting practice, reporting to the Managing Partner.

Core Responsibilities

Practice Operations, Systems & Continuous Improvement

Develop and maintain templates, checklists, trackers and standard documents that improve consistency, quality and efficiency across the practice.
Prepare, format and proofread client materials, reports, presentations, project updates and internal documents.
Input, clean, organize and maintain project, survey and assessment data.
Document recurring processes and identify opportunities to simplify, standardize and automate how work gets done.
Leverage AI and other technology tools to reduce administrative effort, improve workflows and create greater capacity across the team.
Help strengthen the systems, processes and infrastructure required to support the continued growth and scalability of the Leadership Consulting practice.

Team & Consultant Support

Act as a key point of contact for external consultants requiring project information, scheduling, materials, access or other support.
Coordinate external consultant invoices, including reviewing required information, submitting invoices to Finance and following up where needed.
Coordinate internal practice initiatives, including the quarterly Leadership Consulting Learning Session.
Prepare agendas, notes, action items and meeting follow-ups as required.
Coordinate information, timelines and materials across consultants and project teams to help everyone stay aligned.

Project Coordination & Delivery

Set up new client engagements, including coordinating required information, signed agreements and project opening with Finance.
Create and maintain a project plan for every engagement, capturing key deliverables, milestones, meetings, responsibilities and next steps.
Proactively follow up on outstanding information, approvals, decisions and deliverables to keep work moving forward.
Maintain organized project files so agreements, plans, materials and current documents are accurate and easy to access.
Coordinate project close-out, including final billing, documentation and archiving.

Scheduling & Logistics

Own scheduling across client engagements, including client meetings, interviews, assessments, debriefs and internal checkpoints.
Coordinate project-based interviews, including participant scheduling, invitations, reminders and completion tracking.
Manage scheduling for the Managing Partner, helping coordinate priorities, resolve conflicts and follow up on outstanding requests.
Coordinate meeting invitations, materials, virtual or in-person logistics and schedule changes.
Anticipate scheduling needs and dependencies rather than waiting for them to become urgent.

Project Tracking & Team Coordination

Maintain a central view of all active engagements, including project status, upcoming milestones, key actions, risks and owners.
Lead the biweekly project update meeting by preparing the agenda, reviewing progress and confirming actions, responsibilities and deadlines.
Update project plans and trackers following meetings and ensure agreed actions are followed through.
Identify upcoming deadlines, potential bottlenecks or risks early and bring them to the attention of the appropriate team members.
Help the team maintain visibility across a growing portfolio of client work.

Psychometric Assessments

Coordinate Hogan, SuccessFinder and other approved psychometric assessments from request through completion.
Set up and administer assessments, monitor completion and provide participant support when required.
Coordinate assessment debriefs and ensure reports are distributed and stored appropriately.
Maintain accurate assessment records and coordinate related billing with Finance.
Serve as a knowledgeable internal resource on assessment administration processes.

Surveys & Feedback Processes

Build, format and test surveys in SurveyMonkey, ThriveSparrow and other approved platforms based on project requirements.
Coordinate participant lists, invitations, reminders, response tracking and survey timelines.
Monitor participation and provide progress updates to the project team and clients.
Provide technical support to participants and troubleshoot issues when needed.
Coordinate approvals before launch and ensure surveys are thoroughly tested.
Close surveys, export and organize results, and maintain accurate final project files.
Support the ongoing relationship with ThriveSparrow, including platform support and invoicing requests.

Key Skills & Qualities

The successful Project Manager will be someone who takes genuine ownership of making things work well. They will bring a combination of strong organization, judgement, follow-through and service orientation.

Exceptional organization and attention to detail

Able to manage many moving pieces across multiple projects without losing sight of important details.
Proactive and anticipatory

Looks ahead, identifies what will be needed and takes action before issues become urgent.
Strong project coordination skills

Comfortable managing timelines, dependencies, deliverables and multiple stakeholders across concurrent engagements.
Ownership and follow-through

Takes responsibility for commitments and sees tasks through to completion rather than simply passing information along.
Sound judgement and prioritization

Able to distinguish what is urgent from what is important, recognize when something needs attention and escalate appropriately.
Clear and professional communication

Communicates effectively and thoughtfully with clients, consultants, senior leaders and internal colleagues.
Client-service mindset

Understands that the quality of coordination and communication is an important part of the overall client experience.
Comfort with technology and systems

Confident learning and working across project management tools, Microsoft Office, survey platforms, assessment systems and other technology.
Process-oriented with a continuous-improvement mindset

Enjoys creating structure, improving processes and finding more efficient and reliable ways of working.
Adaptability

Comfortable working in a fast-moving professional services environment where priorities and timelines can change.
Discretion and professionalism

Able to handle confidential client, assessment and leadership information with care and sound judgement.
Collaborative and dependable

Works well as part of a small, highly collaborative team and can be counted on to keep commitments and support others when needed.

jobs.description:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We are seeking a Manufacturing Operations and Industrial Engineer Program Manager to help us fuel AWS' explosive growth. In this role, you will be a key technical contributor to factory layout and material flow design across AWS rack fulfillment manufacturing sites. Working at the intersection of capacity planning, automation engineering, construction, and operations — spanning EC2, Machine Learning, and Storage hardware platforms — you will develop and execute layout solutions that enable AWS to meet datacenter capacity commitments. Your work will ensure manufacturing infrastructure scales efficiently, reliably, and repeatably. Possessing strong technical depth, analytical rigor, and the ability to influence cross-functional partners are critical elements of success for this role. You will apply manufacturing standards and process control guidelines to assure flawless ramp into volume manufacturing.

Key job responsibilities

Translate rack fulfillment capacity plans into data-driven facility layouts for AWS manufacturing operations, designing end-to-end material flow from dock receipt through assembly, integration, test, and dispatch across EC2, Machine Learning, and Storage product platforms

Design factory floor layouts including automation line stations, manual assembly zones, test positions, sub-assembly areas, burn-in, and repair workflows — analyzing optimal buffer sizing, automation vs. manual line trade-offs, and material handling system specifications (AMR/AGV routes, conveyors, ASRS) based on cycle time analysis, volume ramp curves, and product mix complexity

Build and maintain industrial simulation models (FlexSim, Plant Simulation, or equivalent) to identify bottlenecks, validate throughput assumptions, optimize material flow paths, and track performance metrics including takt time adherence, buffer occupancy, and transport cycle times

Coordinate utility and infrastructure requirements (power, cooling, network, compressed air) for each production zone with facilities and construction teams, ensuring infrastructure readiness aligns with layout phasing — particularly for high-density ML accelerator and Storage rack configurations requiring liquid cooling and high-power distribution

Support phased layout plans aligned with construction milestones, enabling production in early zones while build-out continues in adjacent areas; contribute to layout change control, produce clear visual documentation (2D/3D layouts, material flow diagrams, phasing overlays), and apply replicable standards across manufacturing sites

Drive continuous improvement by maintaining the factory layout as a living document, partnering with Operations, Test, Process, and Automation Engineering teams to implement optimizations that reduce cycle time, improve throughput toward manufacturing-to-ship SLA targets, and support rapid capacity deployment for new product platform introductions

Communicate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders, providing concise and precise updates on layout progress, risks, and recommendations

Champion Automation best practices within the team, contributing to knowledge sharing and training efforts

Manage multiple concurrent workstreams of moderate complexity, balancing priorities across projects and delivering results with minimal supervision

About The Team

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Location: 100% Remote (LATAM — US Eastern Timezone Overlap)
Engagement: Full-Time, Long-Term Contractor

About DualNova
DualNova connects top-tier Latin American technology and operations leaders with established US enterprises as long-term, embedded members of their core teams.

About the Role
We are looking for an exceptional, ownership-driven Senior Agile Project & Program Manager to join the PMO and Executive Technology leadership of an established ~$50M US Customer Experience & Contact Center enterprise undergoing a major operational and technology transformation.

We are NOT looking for a passive project coordinator or software Scrum Master who merely schedules ceremonies and updates tickets. We need a pragmatic operational leader who can independently own complex, cross-functional workstreams from ambiguous business objectives to measurable operational adoption—without introducing big-company bureaucracy.

In this role, delivering a tool or process is only half the job; driving organizational change, training, stakeholder alignment, and real floor/workforce adoption is equally critical.

What You Will Own
• End-to-End Workstream Execution: Take high-level business and operational objectives, define clear scope, organize cross-functional teams, proactively manage dependencies/risks/blockers, challenge assumptions, and drive measurable business outcomes.
• Jira Architecture & Execution ("Jira Ninja"): Design, structure, and administer Jira projects, custom workflows, boards, dependency tracking, JQL filters, automations, and executive dashboards—using Jira as an active engine to drive accountability and execution rather than passive task logging.
• Pragmatic Agile & Hybrid Delivery: Apply Scrum, Kanban, Waterfall, or hybrid frameworks pragmatically based on what each operational or technical initiative actually requires.
• Organizational Change Management & Adoption: Lead stakeholder alignment, communication plans, training programs, and floor-level adoption across operational and technical teams so new technologies (AI, automation, analytics) and processes stick and deliver ROI.
• Operational & Workforce Transformation: Drive business process improvements, workforce management (WFM) initiatives, agent productivity programs, client implementations, and technology rollouts.

• Executive Synthesis & KPI Governance: Distill complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives into concise milestones, decisions needed, risks, KPIs, and next actions for C-level and VP leadership.

Must-Have Requirements
• 6+ years of hands-on Project / Program Management experience driving operational transformations, business process improvements, and cross-functional technology adoption (more important than pure software-only PM experience).

• "Jira Ninja" proficiency: proven hands-on expertise building Jira workflows, boards, automations, JQL queries, cross-project dependencies, and executive reporting dashboards from scratch.
• Pragmatic mastery of Agile (Scrum, Kanban) and Hybrid/Waterfall delivery models.
• Proven Change Management track record (e.g., Prosci/ADKAR or equivalent practical experience driving user adoption, training, and organizational change).
• Strong analytical and business mindset: deep fluency with operational KPIs, SLA/ROI tracking, and continuous improvement.
• C1/C2 Fluent English (spoken and written): concise, direct executive communication style with full US business hours overlap.

Strongly Preferred (Big Pluses)
• Direct experience in Contact Center Operations or BPO Program Management (workforce management/WFM, agent productivity, client implementations, call/contact center KPIs such as SLA, AHT, Occupancy, Shrinkage, FCR, NPS).
• Experience leading the operational adoption of AI, RPA, automation, or analytics tools.
• Lean / Six Sigma certification (Green Belt or Black Belt) or proven continuous improvement methodology.
• Technical delivery or software engineering literacy.

Type: Full time.

Works with: our CEO, our COO, our Full Stack Agentic Developer, and each client's project team, IT lead and executive sponsor.
Start date: Immediate.

About Brainverse

Brainverse builds custom AI agent solutions for businesses, from small companies to enterprises near $1 billion in revenue. Some run on IP we own. Others are built from scratch for one client, such as an agent team that runs part of their operations inside their own environment.

We run our own company the same way: more than 100 agents work across our sales, marketing, delivery and engineering every day. Our signed work is growing faster than our team, and this role owns client delivery.

The role

You run client projects from signed scope to go-live, and you are the client's main point of contact for the life of the project.

Projects arrive with a signed scope, an architecture and an initial design. Your job is the thousand details between that design and a working system in the client's environment: you find the open questions, get the answers, turn them into requirements the developer can build from, and keep every date honest.

This is a technical role without production code. You will be in technical conversations every day: with a client's IT team about their cloud, identity and security review; with our developer about what is ready; and with the AI agents we use to plan, track and draft.

What you'll do

Fill in the details:

Take the signed scope and design and work out everything the build still needs to know: data sources, user roles, integrations, edge cases, environment and security constraints.

Ask the client the questions that close each gap, before the build reaches it.

Turn the answers into requirements and acceptance criteria clear enough to build and test from.

Run the project

Turn the scope into a plan with milestones, owners, dependencies and dates.

Run the weekly client sync, send a written update after each one, and keep a running log of decisions and open questions.

Chase answers on both sides. When a date is going to slip, you know first and bring a plan.

Manage scope. A new request mid-project gets documented, sized with the developer, and approved as a change before anyone builds it.

Get it running in the client's environment

Work with the client's IT team on everything a deployment needs: cloud access, identity and single sign-on, network and firewall rules, hosting, data access and security review.

Own the IT prerequisites list for each project and drive it to done. Clients run on Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, on-premises servers and a wide mix of business systems.

Coordinate cutover and go-live so the client's people know what changes and when.

Keep the work visible and true

Keep the task board current every day: every task has an owner and a date, and overdue work gets a new date or gets raised.

Test what comes back against the requirements before the client sees it.

Acknowledge client support requests during the project the same business day, route technical issues to the right person, and confirm when they're closed.

Make delivery repeatable

Write and improve our delivery playbooks: kickoff, IT prerequisites, weekly sync, go-live and handoff.

Build the systems and agent workflows that make the next project faster than the last.

Not part of this role

Winning new clients or growing existing accounts. That stays with leadership.

Writing production code or designing the architecture.

What we're looking for

Must have

5 or more years delivering business software into customer environments, as an implementation manager, technical project manager, solutions or deployment engineer, or technical account manager.

You have run several client projects at once, start to finish, with real dates and real accountability.

You know how software gets deployed and secured inside a company: cloud and on-premises hosting, identity and single sign-on, permissions, networking basics, and what an IT security review asks for.

You turn a messy client conversation into a clear written list of what is decided, what is open, and who owes what by when.

Excellent communication in fluent English: written, on video calls, and in person when a client needs it. You are as clear with a client's IT lead as with their executive sponsor.

You use AI tools daily to plan, draft, summarize and analyze real work, and can show us how.

You notice what is about to slip before anyone else does, and you act on it without being asked.

You want a fast, demanding startup pace. Hours aren't fixed. Communication seven days a week is expected; working seven days a week is not.

Work samples (plans, requirements, status reports or playbooks, with confidential details removed).

Nice to have

Experience growing client accounts through relationships across an organization.

PMP, Scrum or a similar certification.

Hands-on administration of Azure, AWS, Google Cloud or Microsoft 365.

Experience with AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor.

Background in construction, mechanical or electrical contracting, or construction software.

Experience at an early-stage company or a consulting firm.

What success looks like

30 days: You've joined every live client project and know each client by name, status and next milestone.

60 days: You lead at least one client project, and the task board reflects reality every day without anyone asking.

90 days: You run several projects with leadership out of the day-to-day, the first delivery playbooks exist, and clients call you first.

How we hire

Intro call. 30 minutes on your background and what you want next.
Client simulation. You get a project briefing a day ahead. Then, in a one-hour call, our team plays the client's leadership and IT team, and you run the conversation.
Conversation with our CEO.
Reference checks.

You don't send references when you apply. We'll ask for them before the reference checks.

Brainverse is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on skill and fit for the role and don't discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Sentra is the AI Data Readiness platform for enterprises deploying AI at scale. Sentra continuously discovers, classifies, and governs sensitive data across cloud, SaaS, data warehouses, and AI environments - giving security teams complete visibility into what AI systems can access, what they can expose, and where compliance violations exist. Unlike alternatives that copy data to vendor clouds or require customer-managed outpost infrastructure, Sentra provisions ephemeral scanners directly inside the customer's environment, delivering petabyte-scale classification at a fraction of the cost. Trusted by Lyft, SoFi, Munich RE, PennyMac, Glovo and others.

About the role
Sentra is hiring its first US Classification Data Analyst to be the go-to expert on data classification for our US customers. You will join the Solutions Architecture team, reporting to the Director of Solutions Architecture, and work closely with our R&D Data Analysts team in Israel.

Classification is what customers judge us on during proofs of value (PoVs) and renewals: do our results match their data? You will make sure the answer is yes. You will own classification requests for US PoVs, validate results before customer calls, tune classifiers using proven procedures, and bring the hard problems to R&D with everything they need to solve them.
This is a high-impact role at a fast-growing startup. You will help build the US classification function from the ground up, and your scope will grow as you take on more of the work.

What you'll do
Be the first point of contact for classification requests from US customers and PoVs, working with Sales Engineers, Solutions Architects, TAMs, Support and Customer Success.
Own classification on PoV engagements: validate results before customer calls and join those calls as the classification expert in the room.
Tune classification using approved procedures: add and remove keywords, build customer-specific regex and dictionary classes, run re-analysis, review customer-built classes and manage allowlists.
Find false positives and false negatives before customers do, and explain clearly why something was classified the way it was and what will change.
Escalate complex issues to the R&D Data Analysts team with a complete, well-written handoff they can act on without a follow-up call.
Track every request and its outcome, and turn that data into insight on volume, trends, and where we can improve.
Proactively look across PoVs to spot what is working, what is not, and what needs to change in our classification, our process, or our runbooks.
Keep our runbooks current: report gaps, propose fixes, and update instructions as the product evolves.

What you'll bring
3+ years in a customer-facing technical role (support engineering, solutions engineering, TAM, data analyst or similar) at a SaaS or security company.
Startup experience. You are comfortable with ambiguity, move fast and take ownership without waiting to be asked.
A proactive mindset. You look for problems and improvements before they become customer issues.
Working SQL. You can write and adapt queries in Athena or a similar engine.
Regular expressions. You can read, write, and test patterns and explain their false positive behavior.
Git and code literacy. You understand how Git and pull requests work and can read and follow code, such as a Python script. You do not need to be a developer, and using AI tools like Claude to help write code is welcome, as long as you understand what the code does.
Clear, structured communication. You can explain technical results to a customer and write a handoff that a teammate can act on without a call.
Location East Coast

Nice to have
Familiarity with data classification, DLP or DSPM concepts (PII, PCI, PHI, data classes, false positive rates).
Exposure to cloud data stores such as S3, Snowflake, Databricks or Microsoft 365, and how sensitive data shows up in them.
Experience with dashboards (Metabase or similar) and ticketing tools (Shortcut, Pylon or similar).

They coordinate between design teams, clients, and consultants, ensuring smooth communication and project flow, and successful execution of budgets, schedules, and quality control. Design

Empowers team members to fully utilize their strengths and grow in their competencies. Takes a proactive and systematic approach to QA/QC to ensure that the project deliverables meet the required quality standards. A successful project manager communicates with principals and studio leaders providing comprehensive updates on project progress, financials, and key decisions, seeking strategic input and guidance throughout the project lifecycle.

Care

Proactively seeks to understand the unique needs, perspectives, and aspirations of all stakeholders, including clients, end-users, and the project team. Cultivates a positive team culture that inspires trust, engagement, and a shared commitment to project success.

Partnership

Engages clients in a collaborative problem-solving process when challenges arise, actively seeking their input and working together to find appropriate solutions that align with their goals and objectives.

Solid understanding of finance processes, including general ledger, month-end close, revenue recognition, and AP/AR.

Advanced NetSuite Saved Searches and basic-to-intermediate SQL skills.
Experience managing functional testing, UAT, and business sign-off.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across business and technical teams.

Experience in distribution, supply chain, inventory, or logistics.
Knowledge of NetSuite lot tracking and costing.
Familiarity with SuiteFlow, SuiteScript, SuiteAnalytics Workbook, or Power BI.

This is a hands-on functional role focused on ongoing NetSuite support, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement, rather than software development. You'll play a key role in helping Finance and Operations get the most out of their ERP platform.

jobs.description:
Why Zensar?

We’re a bunch of hardworking, fun-loving, people-oriented technology enthusiasts. We love what we do, and we’re passionate about helping our clients thrive in an increasingly complex digital world. Zensar is an organization focused on building relationships with our clients and with each other—and happiness is at the core of everything we do. We’ve learned that employee happiness requires more than a competitive paycheck, and our employee value proposition—grow, own, achieve, learn (GOAL)—lays out the core opportunities we seek to foster for every employee. Teamwork and collaboration are critical to Zensar’s mission and success, and our teams work on a diverse and challenging mix of technologies across a broad industry spectrum. These industries include banking and financial services, high-tech and manufacturing, healthcare, insurance, retail, and consumer services. Our employees enjoy flexible work arrangements and a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), among other benefits. If you are looking for a place to have an immediate impact, to grow and contribute, where we work hard, play hard, and support each other, consider joining team Zensar!

Zensar is looking for a MDM Business Analyst in the United States (Hybrid). This position is open for Full Time with excellent benefits and professional growth opportunities.

About the Role

MDM requirements

Run on-site discovery and requirements workshops with business and IT stakeholders for in-scope domains such as Customer, Account, Contact and Product.
Document business requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria. Define golden record attributes, data ownership and the systems of record.
Work out business rules for match criteria, trust and survivorship, and hierarchies with the MDM Solution Architect and DQ Analyst.
Prepare source-to-target mappings, attribute-level data dictionaries and business glossary entries.
Maintain the requirements traceability matrix and manage requirement changes through the change control process.

Data stewardship processes

Design end-to-end data stewardship processes: create/update approvals, duplicate review, merge/unmerge decisions and exception handling.
Define steward roles, responsibilities, task queues, SLAs and escalation paths in MDM SaaS.
Document data governance policies, data ownership (RACI) and data standards for mastered entities.
Prepare steward SOPs, process flows and training material. Lead steward onboarding and training sessions.

Salesforce CRM data

Analyze the Salesforce CRM data model: Accounts, Contacts, Leads, Opportunities, record types, account hierarchies, custom objects and fields.
Find Salesforce data quality issues such as duplicates, incomplete records and inconsistent account hierarchies, and define how to fix them.
Define the business rules for syncing golden records back to Salesforce, including field ownership, conflict resolution and duplicate prevention (search-before-create).
Work with the client’s Salesforce admins and sales/service operations teams on process changes after MDM goes live.

Client engagement (onshore)

Act as the main functional contact for client business sponsors, data owners and stewards.
Get timely business sign-offs on requirements, match and survivorship rules, stewardship processes and UAT.
Present requirements, process designs and open decisions in status meetings and steering committees.

Onshore–offshore coordination

Turn client requirements and decisions into clear functional specs for the offshore MDM, CDI, DQ and QA teams.
Run regular overlap calls with the offshore team to clarify requirements and resolve functional questions.
Review offshore deliverables (designs, test cases, UAT scripts) to check they meet business needs.

Testing and go-live support

Help the QA team build test scenarios, and lead UAT planning and execution with business users and data stewards.
Validate match/merge and survivorship outcomes against business expectations.
Support change management, user training, cutover and go-live on site.

Experience:

MDM requirements:
3+ years as a Business Analyst on MDM programs. This must include defining golden record attributes, match/merge and survivorship business rules, hierarchies and source-to-target mappings. Informatica MDM SaaS experience is preferred.
Data stewardship processes:
hands-on experience designing data stewardship workflows, steward roles and SLAs, governance policies and data ownership (RACI) models.
Salesforce CRM data:
strong knowledge of the Salesforce CRM data model (Accounts, Contacts, Leads, account hierarchies, custom objects) and common Salesforce data quality challenges such as duplicates and hierarchy inconsistencies.

Education:

Bachelor’s / Master’s Degree – Information Technology

new_jobs.title: Project Manager - Higgs Audio (Toronto)
new_jobs.description:
About The Role

Boson AI builds real-time speech and multimodal AI that makes talking to AI feel like talking to people. Higgs Audio is our family of foundation audio and avatar models. They generate natural speech, recognize speech in many languages, clone a voice from a short sample, detect sentiment, and give a voice a face. Higgs TTS 3, an expressive, open-weight text-to-speech model with zero-shot voice cloning, also powers Higgs VoiceOver, which brings directable AI voice-over into video editors. Customers use Higgs Audio through our API, through hosting partners such as Microsoft Foundry and Deep Infra, and as open weights. Thousands of developers already build on our open models on GitHub and Hugging Face.

We are hiring a Project Manager to run Higgs Audio from research to release. You will plan and ship its releases, hold every release to a clear quality bar, decide which issues get fixed first, keep the schedule on track, and bring what customers tell us back to the team. You will work with the researchers who train the models, the engineers who serve them, and the customers who use them.

This is a hands-on role. You don't need to train models, but you need to be technical enough to reproduce a bug against our API, read an evaluation report, listen critically to generated speech, and tell a real regression from noise. You will start as a senior individual contributor with real ownership of the Higgs Audio releases and roadmap.

The role is based at either our Santa Clara HQ or our Toronto office, on a hybrid schedule with at least three days a week in the office. Expect occasional travel between the two offices and to customers. The ability to speak multiple languages is a plus.

What You'll Do

Own Higgs Audio releases from plan to launch. Set the release schedule, run go/no-go reviews, and make sure each release ships with documentation, release notes, an updated model card and a changelog entry
Coordinate every channel a release goes out on: our API and Boson Workspace, open weights on Hugging Face, our GitHub repositories, hosting partners such as Microsoft Foundry and Deep Infra. Keep them in step, so that no channel falls a version behind without a reason
Run quality control. Work with research and engineering to define the bar a release must clear: error rates across 100+ languages, voice-cloning similarity, expressiveness benchmarks such as our EmergentTTS-Eval, listening tests, latency and cost. Hold every release to it, and catch regressions before customers do
Own the issue queue. Triage bug reports and feature requests from GitHub, customer support, partners and our own teams, set severity and priority, get each one to an owner, and close the loop with whoever reported it
Keep the schedule. Break goals into milestones, track the dependencies between research, engineering and go-to-market, raise risks early, and make tradeoffs explicit when something has to give
Bring the customer into the room. Talk to developers, enterprise customers, partners and creators, run beta programs, read usage data and support tickets, and turn what you learn into clear requirements and priorities for the team
Make sure model changes land smoothly in the products built on them, such as Higgs VoiceOver, which runs on Higgs TTS 3
Own versioning and deprecation: version names, migration guides, and deprecation notices that give customers time to move before a breaking change
Report what is working. Track metrics such as release cadence, regressions that reached customers, time to resolve critical issues, adoption and customer satisfaction, and send a regular status update that leadership can read in five minutes

What Success Looks Like In Your First Six Months

Higgs Audio ships on a predictable, published release schedule, and every release clears a documented quality bar before it goes out
Every open issue, from our public repos and from customers, has an owner and a priority, and critical bugs are fixed within an agreed time
Customers can follow every model and API change in a public changelog, with notice ahead of any breaking change
A regular customer report drives the Higgs Audio roadmap, and its top requests are scheduled or shipped

Minimum Qualifications

5+ years of project, program or product management on software products, including at least 2 years on technical products such as APIs, developer platforms or ML models
A track record of shipping on schedule: you have run release processes and launch checklists, made go/no-go calls, and can point to releases you were responsible for
Technical fluency: comfortable with Python, REST and streaming APIs, GitHub and issue trackers, and able to reproduce a bug, read logs, and analyze evaluation results in SQL, a spreadsheet or a notebook
Experience turning customer conversations and usage data into prioritized requirements, and the judgment to say no
Clear, concise writing in specs, release notes and status updates
Ability to use agentic AI efficiently in your work, so you can deliver at superhuman level
Able to work from our Santa Clara HQ or our Toronto office on a hybrid schedule

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with speech or audio products, such as TTS, ASR, voice cloning, voice agents, or audio for media production
Experience releasing ML models: evaluation suites, human preference studies, model cards, and open-weight releases on Hugging Face
Experience managing the issues, pull requests and releases of an open-source project on GitHub
Experience with enterprise customers or cloud partners such as Microsoft Foundry, AWS Bedrock or Google Vertex AI
A good ear: you notice when a voice sounds off, and you can say what is wrong
An engineering background, or a degree in computer science, electrical engineering or a related field
Fluency in a language besides English. Our models speak 100+ of them

Boson AI is building AI that people can simply talk to. If you want to own how our speech models reach the people who use them, we'd love to hear from you. Please tell us about releases or products you have shipped and the part you played in them.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. new_jobs.description:
About Charge

Charge Robotics is a Series A startup building robots that build solar farms.

Demand for new solar projects is booming (one-fifth of all the solar that exists in the US was installed last year!), but today’s construction companies can’t keep up due to limited labor resources.

We thought this was insane, so we developed robots to directly address this bottleneck and speed up the world’s transition to renewables. We’ve shipped our first commercial system already, and are in the process of scaling up our operations to meet our massive demand.

Charge is a fast-moving company, which means constant opportunities for learning and growth. You’ll have a large impact on the direction of our company and our product, which will be reflected in significant equity compensation. And you get to work with 🤖 giant robots 🤖.

If you are excited to work on interesting technical problems with direct climate impact, you’re going to fit right in at Charge Robotics.

Read more about Charge in recent press:

Fast Company - Solar Building Robots to Solve One of Climate's Biggest Problems
MIT News - Making solar projects cheaper and faster with portable factories
YouTube - full video of our Gen1 robots building a solar farm

Charge’s funding:

We’re MIT-founded and backed by Silicon Valley’s top investors, including Founders Fund, Energy Impact Partners, Lux Capital, YC (S21), and more.

About The Role

Charge Robotics is hiring a Technical Project Manager (TPM) to own one of our most important new project: adapting our Sunrise system for a new deployment, taking it through an engineering development cycle and international field deployment. You'll be the connective tissue across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, commercial, and field teams — keeping a complex, multi-workstream effort on schedule and on spec from design through deployment.

What You'll Be Working On

Own the end-to-end project plan and schedule for the engineering development and deployment effort, coordinating across commercial, leadership, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and field teams
Drive the design adaptation cycle for the new system — tracking requirements, design reviews, and milestones from concept through production readiness
Collaborate with supply chain to manage external vendors and contract manufacturers to meet timelines, deliverables, and quality requirements
Plan and coordinate international deployment logistics (freight, mobilization, and on-site readiness) in partnership with field, engineering, and customer teams
Maintain a clear view of risks, dependencies, and critical path; surface tradeoffs and keep stakeholders aligned on status and decisions

You

Have 4+ years of technical program or project management experience, ideally with complex hardware systems
Have excellent organizational and communication skills, with a track record of driving alignment across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and external partners
Operate effectively amid ambiguity in the fast-paced environment of a rapidly growing startup
Are based in or can relocate to the SF Bay Area, and able to work 4-5 days/week from our San Leandro HQ
Are open to travel (including international) to support manufacturing and deployment, and excited to see our robots deployed onto actual solar farms!

It'd also be nice if you

Have managed international hardware deployments or worked with overseas vendors and logistics
Are familiar with one or multiple of our intersecting industries: solar, robotics, construction
Are motivated by playing a direct role in fighting climate change by accelerating the transition to renewables

Equal Opportunity Employer

new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We are seeking a Manufacturing Operations and Industrial Engineer Program Manager to help us fuel AWS' explosive growth. In this role, you will be a key technical contributor to factory layout and material flow design across AWS rack fulfillment manufacturing sites. Working at the intersection of capacity planning, automation engineering, construction, and operations — spanning EC2, Machine Learning, and Storage hardware platforms — you will develop and execute layout solutions that enable AWS to meet datacenter capacity commitments. Your work will ensure manufacturing infrastructure scales efficiently, reliably, and repeatably. Possessing strong technical depth, analytical rigor, and the ability to influence cross-functional partners are critical elements of success for this role. You will apply manufacturing standards and process control guidelines to assure flawless ramp into volume manufacturing.

Key job responsibilities

Translate rack fulfillment capacity plans into data-driven facility layouts for AWS manufacturing operations, designing end-to-end material flow from dock receipt through assembly, integration, test, and dispatch across EC2, Machine Learning, and Storage product platforms

Design factory floor layouts including automation line stations, manual assembly zones, test positions, sub-assembly areas, burn-in, and repair workflows — analyzing optimal buffer sizing, automation vs. manual line trade-offs, and material handling system specifications (AMR/AGV routes, conveyors, ASRS) based on cycle time analysis, volume ramp curves, and product mix complexity

Build and maintain industrial simulation models (FlexSim, Plant Simulation, or equivalent) to identify bottlenecks, validate throughput assumptions, optimize material flow paths, and track performance metrics including takt time adherence, buffer occupancy, and transport cycle times

Coordinate utility and infrastructure requirements (power, cooling, network, compressed air) for each production zone with facilities and construction teams, ensuring infrastructure readiness aligns with layout phasing — particularly for high-density ML accelerator and Storage rack configurations requiring liquid cooling and high-power distribution

Support phased layout plans aligned with construction milestones, enabling production in early zones while build-out continues in adjacent areas; contribute to layout change control, produce clear visual documentation (2D/3D layouts, material flow diagrams, phasing overlays), and apply replicable standards across manufacturing sites

Drive continuous improvement by maintaining the factory layout as a living document, partnering with Operations, Test, Process, and Automation Engineering teams to implement optimizations that reduce cycle time, improve throughput toward manufacturing-to-ship SLA targets, and support rapid capacity deployment for new product platform introductions

Communicate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders, providing concise and precise updates on layout progress, risks, and recommendations

Champion Automation best practices within the team, contributing to knowledge sharing and training efforts

Manage multiple concurrent workstreams of moderate complexity, balancing priorities across projects and delivering results with minimal supervision

About The Team

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of technical product management, program management or engineering experience
7+ years of working cross functionally across several teams experience, or a Bachelor's degree and 6+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience
Associate's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field, or 3+ years of industrial engineer, operations engineer, manufacturing engineer, or project engineer in a manufacturing environment experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Preferred Qualifications

5+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
3+ years of in material handling equipment (MHE) or automation environments experience, or experience with simulation and 3D modeling software
Experience with Six Sigma, lean manufacturing, or experience building launch readiness frameworks, standard work, playbooks, and scalable deployment mechanisms across multiple concurrent sites
Experience with high-density hardware manufacturing environments requiring specialized infrastructure (e.g., liquid cooling, high-power distribution, or data center rack integration)

Job Summary

The Technical Project Manager is responsible for coordinating and managing implementation projects that support resilient information technology components within transit-related capital construction initiatives. These may include electrical systems, communications infrastructure, network components ,and data centre–related technologies.The Project Manager oversees project planning, stakeholdercoordination, and technical review cycles while ensuring project execution across multiple concurrent efforts in various stages of design, construction,and closeout. As a core member of the PMO, the Project Manager also administersthe organization’s PPM tool, managing user setup, permissions, training, and governance workflows.

Responsibilities:

• Coordinate construction projects for IT components, managing multiple ongoing projects at varying stages of design, review, construction, and implementation.
• Coordinate technical design reviews of IT, communications, electrical, and network components developed by Engineering teams or external consultants.
• Facilitate review cycles by capturing feedback, consolidating SME comments, and ensuring timely resolution of issues.
• Serve as liaison among technical SMEs, Engineering, IT, vendors, and construction teams to ensure technical requirements are understood andaccurately incorporated.
• Support construction oversight by coordinating SME site visits, inspections, and documentation reviews, ensuring issues are tracked through resolution.
• Review project documentation such as drawings, specifications, network diagrams, shop drawings, and RFIs, and route them to appropriate SMEs forvalidation.
• Coordinate and manage RFIs, submittals, and design clarifications with theappropriate SMEs and stakeholders.
• Manage implementation activities for IT and network components by coordinating specialist involvement.
