• Lead project teams to define business requirements, develop schedules, and ensure successful on-time, on-budget delivery.
• Manage project execution within staffing, budget, and resource constraints.
• Host project meetings and provide clear, concise project updates to stakeholders and leadership.
• Identify, track, and mitigate risks and issues to minimize impacts to delivery timelines.
• Serve as primary liaison among sponsors, stakeholders, project teams, and vendors to ensure alignment and effective communication.
• Administer the PPM tool, including user account management, profile and permissions configuration, training coordination, project intake workflows, and coordination with IT on enhancements or issues.
• Coordinate with business partners to ensure teams receive necessary project-related or systems-related training.

Requirements:

• Minimum of ten (10) years managing large, complex infrastructure or technology projects.
• Experience with plan review processes and construction documentation workflows; familiarity with NJDCA permitting processes preferred.
• Strong experience coordinating technical review cycles and working with SMEs across engineering and IT disciplines.
• Experience reviewing network diagrams, schedules, shop drawings, RFIs, and specifications.
• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office and MS Visio.
• Experience with AutoCAD and CSI-format documents (review-level experience acceptable).
• Proven ability to prioritize, delegate, and manage multiple concurrent projects.
• Demonstrated experience leading project teams from initiation through implementation.
• Experience with Planview or other PPM tools (Clarity, HP PPM, etc.).
• Strong communication skills with business leaders, technical SMEs, stakeholders, and vendors.
• Proven capability in risk management and issue resolution.

Education and Certifications:

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering or a relatedtechnical discipline.
• RCDD certification preferred.
• PMP or equivalent project management certification highly preferred.

Compensation: $1,000 – $2,000 USD/month ($12,000 – $24,000 USD/year + performance bonuses)
Location: 100% Remote (LATAM — US Eastern Timezone Overlap)
Engagement: Full-Time, Long-Term Contractor

About DualNova
DualNova connects top-tier Latin American technology and operations leaders with established US enterprises as long-term, embedded members of their core teams.

About the Role
We are looking for an exceptional, ownership-driven Senior Agile Project & Program Manager to join the PMO and Executive Technology leadership of an established ~$50M US Customer Experience & Contact Center enterprise undergoing a major operational and technology transformation.

We are NOT looking for a passive project coordinator or software Scrum Master who merely schedules ceremonies and updates tickets. We need a pragmatic operational leader who can independently own complex, cross-functional workstreams from ambiguous business objectives to measurable operational adoption—without introducing big-company bureaucracy.

In this role, delivering a tool or process is only half the job; driving organizational change, training, stakeholder alignment, and real floor/workforce adoption is equally critical.

What You Will Own
• End-to-End Workstream Execution: Take high-level business and operational objectives, define clear scope, organize cross-functional teams, proactively manage dependencies/risks/blockers, challenge assumptions, and drive measurable business outcomes.
• Jira Architecture & Execution ("Jira Ninja"): Design, structure, and administer Jira projects, custom workflows, boards, dependency tracking, JQL filters, automations, and executive dashboards—using Jira as an active engine to drive accountability and execution rather than passive task logging.
• Pragmatic Agile & Hybrid Delivery: Apply Scrum, Kanban, Waterfall, or hybrid frameworks pragmatically based on what each operational or technical initiative actually requires.
• Organizational Change Management & Adoption: Lead stakeholder alignment, communication plans, training programs, and floor-level adoption across operational and technical teams so new technologies (AI, automation, analytics) and processes stick and deliver ROI.
• Operational & Workforce Transformation: Drive business process improvements, workforce management (WFM) initiatives, agent productivity programs, client implementations, and technology rollouts.

• Executive Synthesis & KPI Governance: Distill complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives into concise milestones, decisions needed, risks, KPIs, and next actions for C-level and VP leadership.

Must-Have Requirements
• 6+ years of hands-on Project / Program Management experience driving operational transformations, business process improvements, and cross-functional technology adoption (more important than pure software-only PM experience).

• "Jira Ninja" proficiency: proven hands-on expertise building Jira workflows, boards, automations, JQL queries, cross-project dependencies, and executive reporting dashboards from scratch.
• Pragmatic mastery of Agile (Scrum, Kanban) and Hybrid/Waterfall delivery models.
• Proven Change Management track record (e.g., Prosci/ADKAR or equivalent practical experience driving user adoption, training, and organizational change).
• Strong analytical and business mindset: deep fluency with operational KPIs, SLA/ROI tracking, and continuous improvement.
• C1/C2 Fluent English (spoken and written): concise, direct executive communication style with full US business hours overlap.

Strongly Preferred (Big Pluses)
• Direct experience in Contact Center Operations or BPO Program Management (workforce management/WFM, agent productivity, client implementations, call/contact center KPIs such as SLA, AHT, Occupancy, Shrinkage, FCR, NPS).
• Experience leading the operational adoption of AI, RPA, automation, or analytics tools.
• Lean / Six Sigma certification (Green Belt or Black Belt) or proven continuous improvement methodology.
• Technical delivery or software engineering literacy.

Sr. Technical Program Manager - Amazon Leo Government Ecommerce

In this role, you will work with engineering teams, product management, and operational stakeholders to execute and document delivery of government customer ecommerce system develpoment, deployment and user acceptance testing (UAT) programs with considerable impact. You will cover the end-to-end development cadence and testing readiness strategy — from test case requirements definition through test automation, stakeholder sign-off, and launch — operating with limited guidance in environments where the business problem, program strategy, and technology solutions may not yet be fully defined.

You will work in a collaborative, analytical, and fast-paced environment and must be comfortable interacting with highly technical cross-functional teams. The candidate must have strong business judgment, dive deep into data, working with engineering teams on technical solution development and trade off; while also be comfortable with proposing and delivering processing tactical actions. Candidates must be able to Multi-task different business operation tasks within Amazon, engineering teams, and external vendors. The best candidates will have deep understanding of prioritization and task completion.

This role will lead complex, cross-organizational technical programs spanning multiple areas within Amazon Leo Government and external partners. Focusing on the customer lifecycle integration and optimization by driving architectural decisions and delivery of mission-critical solutions across Amazon Leo internal ecommerce and support systems, SAP, ServiceNow and other related platforms while ensuring alignment with government service requirements and commercial capabilities.

Key job responsibilities

Key Job Responsibilities

Program Definition & Strategy - Define the B2G customer UAT automation program mission, vision, and tenets for testing programs - Set clear objectives and create plans with measurable success criteria - Influence resource allocation decisions across engineering and business teams - Own organizational test roadmaps including OP1/OP2 narrative contributions

Stakeholder Alignment & Decision-Making - Drive alignment discussions with business and technical stakeholders to ensure crisp decisions on scope, schedule, and quality - Partner with accounting, security and engineering teams to prioritize and sequence testing work.

UAT & Testing Ownership - Plan and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with operations, security, finance, accounting and tax stakeholders, end users, and ALG software engineering teams before each release or launch - Assess engineering development processes, test plans, and operations/maintenance requirements - Help teams reduce exposure to classic failure modes including insufficient testing and gaps in QA - Lead participation in Unit Testing, System Integration Testing (SIT), UAT, and User Training - Define measurable success criteria for testing phases and ensure readiness gates are met before go-live

Technical Oversight - Understand ecommerce system limitations, scaling factors, boundary conditions, and the reasons for architectural decisions relevant to testing - Oversee gaps between teams, processes, and system architectures that affect test coverage - Streamline and eliminate excess process; work with teams to improve concurrent delivery and testing cycles - Hold engineering teams to a high standard for solutions and engineering practices

Risk Management - Proactively identify and mitigate risks before they become roadblocks - Be data-driven; regularly review quality metrics and seek improved visibility mechanisms - Demonstrate good judgment in how and when to escalate

Communication & Leadership - Write effective narratives (Amazon 6-pagers) and present to Directors and VPs - Clearly communicate development and testing progress, outcomes, and defect resolution to broad audiences.

Security Clearance: This position requires that the selected candidate be a US Citizen and must be able to obtain and maintain a US Government security clearance of TS/SCI.

5+ years of technical product or program management experience
7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
3+ years of software development experience
5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

new_jobs.description:
Location: Remote, United States or Canada.
Core hours: 8 AM to 5 PM US Eastern, weekdays.
Type: Full time.
Compensation: Up to $150,000 USD base, depending on experience. Eligible for bonus and additional compensation after year one.
Works with: our CEO, our COO, our Full Stack Agentic Developer, and each client's project team, IT lead and executive sponsor.
Start date: Immediate.

About Brainverse

Brainverse builds custom AI agent solutions for businesses, from small companies to enterprises near $1 billion in revenue. Some run on IP we own. Others are built from scratch for one client, such as an agent team that runs part of their operations inside their own environment.

We run our own company the same way: more than 100 agents work across our sales, marketing, delivery and engineering every day. Our signed work is growing faster than our team, and this role owns client delivery.

The role

You run client projects from signed scope to go-live, and you are the client's main point of contact for the life of the project.

Projects arrive with a signed scope, an architecture and an initial design. Your job is the thousand details between that design and a working system in the client's environment: you find the open questions, get the answers, turn them into requirements the developer can build from, and keep every date honest.

This is a technical role without production code. You will be in technical conversations every day: with a client's IT team about their cloud, identity and security review; with our developer about what is ready; and with the AI agents we use to plan, track and draft.

What you'll do

Fill in the details:

Take the signed scope and design and work out everything the build still needs to know: data sources, user roles, integrations, edge cases, environment and security constraints.

Ask the client the questions that close each gap, before the build reaches it.

Turn the answers into requirements and acceptance criteria clear enough to build and test from.

Run the project

Turn the scope into a plan with milestones, owners, dependencies and dates.

Run the weekly client sync, send a written update after each one, and keep a running log of decisions and open questions.

Chase answers on both sides. When a date is going to slip, you know first and bring a plan.

Manage scope. A new request mid-project gets documented, sized with the developer, and approved as a change before anyone builds it.

Get it running in the client's environment

Work with the client's IT team on everything a deployment needs: cloud access, identity and single sign-on, network and firewall rules, hosting, data access and security review.

Own the IT prerequisites list for each project and drive it to done. Clients run on Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, on-premises servers and a wide mix of business systems.

Coordinate cutover and go-live so the client's people know what changes and when.

Keep the work visible and true

Keep the task board current every day: every task has an owner and a date, and overdue work gets a new date or gets raised.

Test what comes back against the requirements before the client sees it.

Acknowledge client support requests during the project the same business day, route technical issues to the right person, and confirm when they're closed.

Make delivery repeatable

Write and improve our delivery playbooks: kickoff, IT prerequisites, weekly sync, go-live and handoff.

Build the systems and agent workflows that make the next project faster than the last.

Not part of this role

Winning new clients or growing existing accounts. That stays with leadership.

Writing production code or designing the architecture.

What we're looking for

Must have

5 or more years delivering business software into customer environments, as an implementation manager, technical project manager, solutions or deployment engineer, or technical account manager.

You have run several client projects at once, start to finish, with real dates and real accountability.

You know how software gets deployed and secured inside a company: cloud and on-premises hosting, identity and single sign-on, permissions, networking basics, and what an IT security review asks for.

You turn a messy client conversation into a clear written list of what is decided, what is open, and who owes what by when.

Excellent communication in fluent English: written, on video calls, and in person when a client needs it. You are as clear with a client's IT lead as with their executive sponsor.

You use AI tools daily to plan, draft, summarize and analyze real work, and can show us how.

You notice what is about to slip before anyone else does, and you act on it without being asked.

You want a fast, demanding startup pace. Hours aren't fixed. Communication seven days a week is expected; working seven days a week is not.

Work samples (plans, requirements, status reports or playbooks, with confidential details removed).

Nice to have

Experience growing client accounts through relationships across an organization.

PMP, Scrum or a similar certification.

Hands-on administration of Azure, AWS, Google Cloud or Microsoft 365.

Experience with AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor.

Background in construction, mechanical or electrical contracting, or construction software.

Experience at an early-stage company or a consulting firm.

What success looks like

30 days: You've joined every live client project and know each client by name, status and next milestone.

60 days: You lead at least one client project, and the task board reflects reality every day without anyone asking.

90 days: You run several projects with leadership out of the day-to-day, the first delivery playbooks exist, and clients call you first.

How we hire

Intro call. 30 minutes on your background and what you want next.
Client simulation. You get a project briefing a day ahead. Then, in a one-hour call, our team plays the client's leadership and IT team, and you run the conversation.
Conversation with our CEO.
Reference checks.

You don't send references when you apply. We'll ask for them before the reference checks.

Brainverse is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on skill and fit for the role and don't discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Description

Do you thrive at the intersection of technology strategy and large-scale program execution? The Amazon Stores Finance Tech Team is looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to lead the strategic evolution of our financial analytics platforms supporting the Global Customer Fulfillment network. This role requires an AI-native mindset — using Generative AI tools and automation as a core part of how you plan, execute, and deliver.

As a Principal Technical Program Manager supporting Global Customer Fulfillment Analytics, you will own the program strategy, multi-team execution, and stakeholder alignment for data solutions delivery, Large Language Model (LLM)-powered reporting workflows, autonomous data pipelines, and scalable platform capabilities across one of Amazon's largest finance organizations. You will orchestrate the transition from legacy systems to a modern data lakehouse architecture, ensuring Finance customers have reliable, performant access to the insights they need. This means navigating interdependent tools and platforms, driving alignment across competing priorities, making high-judgment calls with incomplete information, and adapting roadmaps as new internal products evolve.

Key job responsibilities

Own the lifecycle of large, complex multi-team technology programs from concept through delivery, defining the long-term roadmap for data solutions, analytics, and platform modernization across Worldwide Operations Finance
Drive consensus among Tech and Finance partners on strategic roadmaps and prioritization; influence the direction of multiple engineering teams and advise senior leaders on program strategy and trade-offs
Lead the transition from legacy financial reporting systems to a modern data lakehouse architecture with AI-powered automated workflows, managing schedules, risks, and success metrics across interdependent teams
Champion the adoption of Generative AI tools and automation across program management workflows, establishing best practices for AI-assisted planning, execution, and reporting
Mentor Technical Program Managers and cross-functional team members, sharing program management best practices and raising the quality of execution across the organization

A day in the life

You start your morning reviewing program metrics and dashboards to identify emerging risks. Mid-morning, you facilitate a cross-team alignment meeting where engineering leads debate technical trade-offs — your role is to guide the discussion toward a clear decision. After lunch, you draft a program update narrative for senior leadership, distilling technical progress into concrete business outcomes. Later, you connect with a partner team to negotiate a dependency timeline and unblock a critical deliverable.

About The Team

The Stores Finance Tech Team builds and operates the data infrastructure and analytics platforms that power financial planning and reporting for Amazon's Global Customer Fulfillment network — a finance organization supporting hundreds of fulfillment and logistics sites worldwide. Our team of engineers, data scientists, and program managers partners closely with Operations Finance leaders to deliver reliable, timely insights that inform capital allocation, cost optimization, and operational decisions at scale.

We are in the middle of a multi-year platform modernization, migrating from legacy reporting systems to a lakehouse architecture augmented by Generative AI capabilities. If you want to shape how a large finance organization consumes and acts on data, this is the team to join.

10+ years of technical product or program management experience
10+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
5+ years of software development experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Architecture from an accredited college or university.

Experience managing capital projects at airports or other complex transportation facilities.
Experience working with public agencies, large infrastructure programs, or owner-side project management teams.
Familiarity with construction contracts, Design-Build delivery, procurement processes, permits, access agreements, and contractor administration.

new_jobs.title: Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Sentra is the AI Data Readiness platform for enterprises deploying AI at scale. Sentra continuously discovers, classifies, and governs sensitive data across cloud, SaaS, data warehouses, and AI environments - giving security teams complete visibility into what AI systems can access, what they can expose, and where compliance violations exist. Unlike alternatives that copy data to vendor clouds or require customer-managed outpost infrastructure, Sentra provisions ephemeral scanners directly inside the customer's environment, delivering petabyte-scale classification at a fraction of the cost. Trusted by Lyft, SoFi, Munich RE, PennyMac, Glovo and others.

About the role
Sentra is hiring its first US Classification Data Analyst to be the go-to expert on data classification for our US customers. You will join the Solutions Architecture team, reporting to the Director of Solutions Architecture, and work closely with our R&D Data Analysts team in Israel.

Classification is what customers judge us on during proofs of value (PoVs) and renewals: do our results match their data? You will make sure the answer is yes. You will own classification requests for US PoVs, validate results before customer calls, tune classifiers using proven procedures, and bring the hard problems to R&D with everything they need to solve them.
This is a high-impact role at a fast-growing startup. You will help build the US classification function from the ground up, and your scope will grow as you take on more of the work.

What you'll do
Be the first point of contact for classification requests from US customers and PoVs, working with Sales Engineers, Solutions Architects, TAMs, Support and Customer Success.
Own classification on PoV engagements: validate results before customer calls and join those calls as the classification expert in the room.
Tune classification using approved procedures: add and remove keywords, build customer-specific regex and dictionary classes, run re-analysis, review customer-built classes and manage allowlists.
Find false positives and false negatives before customers do, and explain clearly why something was classified the way it was and what will change.
Escalate complex issues to the R&D Data Analysts team with a complete, well-written handoff they can act on without a follow-up call.
Track every request and its outcome, and turn that data into insight on volume, trends, and where we can improve.
Proactively look across PoVs to spot what is working, what is not, and what needs to change in our classification, our process, or our runbooks.
Keep our runbooks current: report gaps, propose fixes, and update instructions as the product evolves.

What you'll bring
3+ years in a customer-facing technical role (support engineering, solutions engineering, TAM, data analyst or similar) at a SaaS or security company.
Startup experience. You are comfortable with ambiguity, move fast and take ownership without waiting to be asked.
A proactive mindset. You look for problems and improvements before they become customer issues.
Working SQL. You can write and adapt queries in Athena or a similar engine.
Regular expressions. You can read, write, and test patterns and explain their false positive behavior.
Git and code literacy. You understand how Git and pull requests work and can read and follow code, such as a Python script. You do not need to be a developer, and using AI tools like Claude to help write code is welcome, as long as you understand what the code does.
Clear, structured communication. You can explain technical results to a customer and write a handoff that a teammate can act on without a call.
Location East Coast

Nice to have
Familiarity with data classification, DLP or DSPM concepts (PII, PCI, PHI, data classes, false positive rates).
Exposure to cloud data stores such as S3, Snowflake, Databricks or Microsoft 365, and how sensitive data shows up in them.
Experience with dashboards (Metabase or similar) and ticketing tools (Shortcut, Pylon or similar).
